data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: RITC of the 2017 years of Syndicates 5820 and 1206
prior_year_events.impact_description: Assumed reserves were included in the 2017 underwriting year column via RITC which produced significant apparent development in the 2017 year column and distorts development analysis.
External reinsurance to close of 2016 & prior years removed brought forward technical provisions in prior reporting; adjustment affects comparatives and reserving presentation.

named_events.loss_description: Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 128m net of reinsurance recoveries, adding 27% to the net loss ratio.
Syndicate's biggest exposure to these was through hurricane Laura (net incurred claims of GBP 21.5m).
Syndicate was exposed to Hurricane Zeta (amount not quantified).
Syndicate was exposed to Hurricane Sally (amount not quantified).
Exposed to a number of smaller US weather events including the Midwest Derecho (amount not quantified).
Several instances of tornadoes and hail storms contributed to catastrophe experience (amounts not quantified).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a modest prior-year reserve deterioration. On a net basis the reserving analysis shows a GBP 7.9m adverse development on prior year claims, principally driven by unfavourable developments in Property, Third party liability (Casualty) and Accident & Health. The gross prior year movement cannot be reliably extracted due to RITC adjustments (assumed reserves from other syndicates) which distort the gross claims development tables, so a net deterioration figure is reported as the best available measure. Current year catastrophe activity and Covid-19 materially increased claims in 2020, but the prior year strengthening primarily reflects adverse claims development on the lines noted.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 128m net of reinsurance recoveries, adding 27% to the net loss ratio.

Catastrophe experience in the year was heavier than expectation and whilst no single loss would be considered market changing on its own, there was a marked increase in the frequency of events contributing 10.7% to the net claims ratio.
The 2018 year of account of Syndicate 1861 accepted the RITC of the 2017 Years of account of Syndicate 5820 and 1206 effective 1 January 2020.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding) prior-year column. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision) is presented unambiguously as a single gross figure; gross claims development triangle is distorted by RITC adjustments (assumed reserves from other syndicates) noted in the disclosures, so the only clear quantified prior-year movement available is a NET deterioration of GBP 7.9m reported in the Net claims note. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is the NET deterioration (fallback) rather than gross - users should treat gross PYD as unavailable due to RITC distortion in the triangle and reconciliation notes.
